# Subway Seat for micro

Copy the `.micro` files to `~/.config/micro/colorschemes/` (on Windows, `%USERPROFILE%\.config\micro\colorschemes`), then pick one with `set colorscheme <name>` from micro's command bar or in `settings.json`. True-color hex; micro maps it to 256 colors when the terminal can't show it.

[micro](https://micro-editor.github.io) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/micro/)

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in ~/.config/micro/settings.json:

```json
"colorscheme": "subway-seat"
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in ~/.config/micro/settings.json:

```json
"colorscheme": "subway-seat-tunnel"
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in ~/.config/micro/settings.json:

```json
"colorscheme": "subway-seat-enamel"
```

**London Moquette**, in ~/.config/micro/settings.json:

```json
"colorscheme": "london-moquette"
```

**London Deep Level**, in ~/.config/micro/settings.json:

```json
"colorscheme": "london-deep-level"
```

**London Portland**, in ~/.config/micro/settings.json:

```json
"colorscheme": "london-portland"
```

**Paris Guimard**, in ~/.config/micro/settings.json:

```json
"colorscheme": "paris-guimard"
```

**Paris Catacombes**, in ~/.config/micro/settings.json:

```json
"colorscheme": "paris-catacombes"
```

**Paris Carrelage**, in ~/.config/micro/settings.json:

```json
"colorscheme": "paris-carrelage"
```

## Uninstall

- Delete `~/.config/micro/colorschemes/subway-seat.micro`.
- Delete `~/.config/micro/colorschemes/subway-seat-tunnel.micro`.
- Delete `~/.config/micro/colorschemes/subway-seat-enamel.micro`.
- Delete `~/.config/micro/colorschemes/london-moquette.micro`.
- Delete `~/.config/micro/colorschemes/london-deep-level.micro`.
- Delete `~/.config/micro/colorschemes/london-portland.micro`.
- Delete `~/.config/micro/colorschemes/paris-guimard.micro`.
- Delete `~/.config/micro/colorschemes/paris-catacombes.micro`.
- Delete `~/.config/micro/colorschemes/paris-carrelage.micro`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.
